name: Nuku'alofa Centre
tagline: The waterfront, the palace and the market
description: The compact centre along the north coast of Tongatapu, with the white timber Royal Palace on the seafront, the Talamahu market and the shops of Taufa'ahau Road. It is flat, walkable and quiet, particularly on Sundays when the law closes it.
bestFor: Anyone needing banks, the market and the ferry terminal
pros: The Royal Palace on the waterfront
cons: Closed entirely on Sundays by law
Little to do in the evening
The town beach is not for swimming

name: The Western Coast
tagline: Out towards the blowholes and the beaches
description: The coast west and southwest of the capital, with the Mapu'a 'a Vaea blowholes where the sea forces through the coral shelf along five kilometres of shore, and a scattering of guesthouses on the quieter beaches. It is rural and undeveloped.
bestFor: Anyone wanting quiet beaches and the blowholes
cons: Thirty to forty minutes from Nuku'alofa

name: Vava'u (northern group, 300 km north)
tagline: The northern islands, and the whales
description: An archipelago of over fifty islands three hundred kilometres north, reached by air or an overnight ferry, and one of the great cruising grounds of the Pacific. It is the base for the licensed humpback swimming between roughly July and October.
bestFor: Sailors and anyone coming for the whales
pros: Licensed humpback whale swimming in season
One of the Pacific's best sailing grounds
Charter fleet and a small yachting community
cons: A flight or overnight ferry from Tongatapu
Busy and expensive in whale season

name: Ha'apai (middle group, 175 km north)
tagline: The middle group, and the emptiest islands
description: The central archipelago between Tongatapu and Vava'u, low coral islands with white beaches and almost no development at all. Lifuka is the main island and the whole group has a few thousand people spread across it.
bestFor: Anyone who wants genuinely empty islands and will accept the trade-offs
pros: Some of the emptiest beaches in the Pacific
Whales pass here too in season
